summary: Implemented App.call_from_thread in src/textual/app.py, with thread-entry state (_loop, _thread_id) initialised in __init__ and set/cleared in run()'s async entry point via try/finally. Added tests/test_concurrency.py with 10 tests covering not-running, same-thread, widget access, awaitable callables, timeout-exception propagation, variadic and keyword forwarding, exit value from a background thread, and calls after run has returned. All 10 pass when run with PYTHONPATH=src using the prepared venv's interpreter. Without PYTHONPATH=src the venv imports the base checkout's textual, so the tests fail and hang. 16 tests in tests/test_widget.py fail both with and without my change (async tests not run in this environment), so they predate it. Nothing committed.
